content:
No, actually 9.9 is greater than 9.11.

When comparing decimals:
- 9.11 = 9 + 0.11
- 9.9 = 9 + 0.9 (or 9 + 0.90)

Since 0.90 > 0.11, we have 9.9 > 9.11

Another way to think about it: 9.9 is just 0.01 away from 10, while 9.11 is much further from 10.
